scope: N7 development evidence audit; no independent quality acceptance or production activation

evidence_policy.history: Existing development results were already inspected; this audit is not blind evaluation.
evidence_policy.integrity: Pin every supplied report and required current source file before the audit. Verify cross-report links. Report hashes bind historical statements; this audit does not rerun model inference or revalidate every historical descendant.
evidence_policy.source_reset: Use original-photo assets and retain mirror age labels solely as research labels; API source_age remains unknown. Unknown labels block absolute-age reset requests.
evidence_policy.quality: No quality pass may be inferred from a boolean in a research report, tests, proxy metrics, same-age generation, or file presence. Independent evaluation, licenses and quality signoff remain missing in this audit version.
evidence_policy.production: The offline evaluator never configures or enables a service; production_enabled is always false. Existing runtime instance, source age and result-asset checks remain required.

output_policy: Create a new directory under ignored output/research; reject existing directories and changed/missing input pins before creating it.
